<style>
:root{color-scheme:light;--bg:#fff;--line:#e9e9e9;--tx:#161616;--mut:#777;--acc:#c9a227;--acc2:#8f6b0c;--om:#ff7900;box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--tx);font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;line-height:1.4}
.w{max-width:1000px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 16px}
.bar{background:#111;color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:12px 16px;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;text-align:center}
.bar button{background:none;border:0;color:#fff;font-size:1.5rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer}
.top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:14px 0}
.sp{flex:1}
.ic{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;border:0;background:#f4f4f4;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.3rem;text-decoration:none;color:var(--tx);cursor:pointer}
.logo{font:italic 900 1.5rem/1 "Arial Narrow",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}
.logo b{color:var(--acc)}
.btn{display:inline-block;border:0;border-radius:12px;padding:11px 16px;font-weight:700;font-size:.95rem;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:none;color:#2a1f00;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0d27a,#c9a227);text-align:center}
.wa{background:#25d366;color:#04210f}
.om{background:var(--om);color:#fff}
.srch{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#f1f1f1;border-radius:14px;padding:0 14px;margin-bottom:4px}
.srch input{flex:1;border:0;background:none;padding:15px 0;font-size:1rem;outline:none;color:var(--tx);min-width:0}
.ban{position:relative;height:200px;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;margin:14px 0;padding:18px;color:#fff;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;box-shadow:0 10px 24px #0002}
.ban h3{margin:0;max-width:70%;font:italic 900 1.5rem/1.05 "Arial Narrow",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}
.ban p{margin:6px 0 0;opacity:.85;font-size:.9rem}
.ban .big{position:absolute;right:16px;top:14px;font-size:5rem;opacity:.9}
.glass{align-self:flex-end;border:0;border-radius:14px;padding:14px 26px;font-weight:700;font-size:1rem;color:#fff;background:#ffffff38;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px);cursor:pointer}
.ttl{display:inline-block;margin:28px 0 6px;padding:10px 36px 10px 6px;font:italic 900 1.9rem/1 "Arial Narrow",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase;background:#f6efdb;clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,92% 100%,0 100%)}
.more{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border:0;background:none;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--tx);padding:6px 0;cursor:pointer}
.more i{font-style:normal;background:#f1f1f1;border-radius:12px;padding:9px 14px;font-weight:700}
.car{display:flex;gap:14px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;padding:12px 2px 18px;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;align-items:stretch}
.car.wrap{flex-wrap:wrap;overflow:visible}
.pc{flex:0 0 56%;max-width:225px;scroll-snap-align:start;border:1px solid #eee;border-radius:18px;background:#fff;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 2px 10px #0000000d;transition:box-shadow .25s,transform .25s}
.pc:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 26px #c9a22733;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.car.wrap .pc{flex:1 1 calc(50% - 7px);max-width:225px}
.pi{position:relative;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:1/1;background:#fff}
.sl{display:flex;height:100%;transition:transform .7s ease}
.sl1{flex:0 0 100%;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:4rem}
.sl1 img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pb{padding:12px 14px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;flex:1}
.pb h4{margin:0;font-size:.98rem;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;height:2.5em;overflow:hidden;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical}
.sws{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;min-height:30px}
.sw{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;border:2px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ddd;padding:0;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;background:#eee}
.sw img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.sw.on{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--acc)}
.sel{width:100%;padding:9px 10px;border:1px solid #e3e3e3;border-radius:10px;font-size:.92rem;background:#fff;color:var(--tx)}
.bt{margin-top:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
.pr{font-size:1.12rem;font-weight:800;color:#161616}
.bt .btn{background:#161616;color:#f0d27a;padding:12px;letter-spacing:.03em;width:100%}
.box{background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid #ecdfb8;border-radius:18px;padding:16px;margin-bottom:12px}
.row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ecdfb8}
.row:last-child{border:0}
.q button{width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--acc);background:#fff;color:var(--acc2);cursor:pointer}
h2.s{font-size:1.3rem;margin:22px 0 10px}
ol{padding-left:20px;margin:8px 0}
.num{font-weight:700;color:var(--om);font-size:1.15rem}
.oi{font-size:.92rem;padding:2px 0;color:#444}
.st{font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--acc2)}
.rf{padding:8px 12px;font-size:.85rem;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--acc)}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);font-size:.85rem;padding:24px 0 130px}
.nav{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;z-index:40;display:flex;background:#fff;border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
.nav button{flex:1;border:0;background:none;padding:10px 4px 9px;font-size:.78rem;font-weight:700;color:#888;cursor:pointer;position:relative}
.nav button span{display:block;font-size:1.3rem;line-height:1.1}
.nav button.on{color:var(--acc2)}
.nav button.on::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:0;left:30%;right:30%;height:3px;border-radius:0 0 3px 3px;background:var(--acc)}
.cnt{position:absolute;top:4px;left:calc(50% + 6px);background:#e53935;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;font-size:.7rem;min-width:18px;padding:1px 5px}
.fab{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:calc(76px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));border-radius:999px;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #0003;z-index:39}
.ov{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#000a;z-index:50;display:none;padding:84px 14px 14px;overflow:auto}
.ov.on{display:block}
.mn{background:#fff;border-radius:22px;padding:10px 24px 20px}
.mi{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:16px 0;cursor:pointer;font:italic 900 1.8rem/1 "Arial Narrow",Impact,system-ui,sans-serif;text-transform:uppercase}
.mi i{font-style:normal;background:#f1f1f1;border-radius:10px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:1.1rem}
.mn hr{border:0;border-top:2px solid var(--line);margin:18px 0 14px}
.cp{font-weight:700;color:var(--tx);text-decoration:none}
.x{position:fixed;top:14px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:66px;height:66px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:#fff;font-size:1.6rem;cursor:pointer;z-index:51}
.gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at top,#fff6d9 0,#fff 60%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;overflow:auto}
.gc{width:100%;max-width:380px;background:#fff;border:1px solid #ecdfb8;border-radius:24px;padding:26px 22px;box-shadow:0 14px 40px #c9a22733}
.gc .logo{font-size:1.9rem;text-align:center;margin-bottom:4px}

.gt{display:flex;background:#f4f4f4;border-radius:12px;padding:4px;margin-bottom:14px}

.in{width:100%;padding:13px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;font-size:1rem;margin:5px 0;color:var(--tx);background:#fff}

.err{color:#c62828;font-size:.88rem;min-height:1.2em;margin-top:4px}
.sm{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--mut);text-align:center;margin-top:12px}
.promo{display:flex;gap:8px;margin:12px 0 0}.promo .in{margin:0;flex:1;min-width:0;text-transform:uppercase}.promo .btn{padding:11px 14px;background:#161616;color:#f0d27a}.lnk{border:0;background:none;color:var(--acc2);text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;font-size:.85rem}

.mk{display:block;flex:0 0 auto}
.gc .logo.lg{justify-content:center}
.cd{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#161616,#3a2e0e);color:#fff;border-radius:18px;padding:14px;margin:10px 0;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;font-size:.92rem}
.cd b{color:#f0d27a}
.cdn{display:flex;gap:8px}
.cdn span{flex:1;background:#ffffff1a;border-radius:10px;padding:6px 4px;text-align:center;font-size:.68rem;color:#f0d27a}

.cd .btn{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f0d27a,#c9a227);color:#2a1f00}
.fr{padding:6px 0}.frb{height:8px;background:#eee;border-radius:99px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:4px}
.frb i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#f0d27a,#c9a227)}
.free{color:#2e7d32}
.sgt{margin:18px 0 8px;font-size:1.05rem}
.sg{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #ecdfb8}
.sg:last-child{border:0}
.sg img{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover;flex:0 0 auto}
.sg>div{min-width:0;font-size:.9rem}
.sg .btn{padding:8px 12px;font-size:.85rem;margin-left:auto;white-space:nowrap}
.hrt{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:3;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;border:0;background:#ffffffe0;color:#bbb;font-size:1.1rem;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.hrt.on{color:#e53935}
.ir{align-items:center;gap:10px}
.ci{width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:12px;object-fit:cover;flex:0 0 auto;background:#f3f3f3;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:1.6rem}
.cp{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:1px;overflow:hidden;padding:0}
.cp img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.im{flex:1;min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;font-size:.92rem}
.fly{position:fixed;z-index:200;border-radius:16px;object-fit:cover;pointer-events:none;transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.5,0,.8,.4),opacity .7s;box-shadow:0 6px 20px #0004}
.toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:calc(84px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px));transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(16px);background:#161616;color:#f0d27a;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:700;font-size:.9rem;z-index:210;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
.toast.on{opacity:1;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.cnt.bump{animation:bump .5s}
@keyframes bump{0%{transform:scale(1)}40%{transform:scale(1.7)}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.nav button.pulse span{animation:wob .55s}
@keyframes wob{0%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}25%{transform:rotate(-14deg) scale(1.2)}60%{transform:rotate(10deg) scale(1.2)}}
</style>
</head>

function $(i){return document.getElementById(i)}
var IDB=null;
function idbOpen(){return new Promise(function(r){try{var q=indexedDB.open("mg",1);q.onupgradeneeded=function(){q.result.createObjectStore("kv")};q.onsuccess=function(){r(q.result)};q.onerror=function(){r(null)}}catch(e){r(null)}})}
function idbGet(k){return new Promise(function(r){if(!IDB)return r(null);try{var q=IDB.transaction("kv").objectStore("kv").get(k);q.onsuccess=function(){r(q.result==null?null:q.result)};q.onerror=function(){r(null)}}catch(e){r(null)}})}
function idbPut(k,v){if(!IDB)return;try{IDB.transaction("kv","readwrite").objectStore("kv").put(v,k)}catch(e){}}
function idbDel(k){if(!IDB)return;try{IDB.transaction("kv","readwrite").objectStore("kv").delete(k)}catch(e){}}
function ld(k){try{var v=localStorage.getItem(k);return v?JSON.parse(v):(MEM[k]||null)}catch(e){return MEM[k]||null}}
function sv(k,v){MEM[k]=v;try{localStorage.setItem(k,JSON.stringify(v))}catch(e){}idbPut(k,v)}
function rm(k){delete MEM[k];try{localStorage.removeItem(k)}catch(e){}idbDel(k)}
function users(){return ld("mg_users")||{}}
function save(){if(!cur)return;var u=users();if(!u[cur])return;u[cur].cart=cart;u[cur].orders=orders;u[cur].idx=idx;u[cur].sel=sel;u[cur].promo=promo;u[cur].ship=ship;u[cur].fav=fav;sv("mg_users",u)}
function esc(s){return String(s).replace(/[&<>"]/g,function(c){return {"&":"&amp;","<":"&lt;",">":"&gt;",'"':"&quot;"}[c]})}
function wa(t){return "https://wa.me/"+NUM+"?text="+encodeURIComponent(t)}
function pr(id){return P.filter(function(x){return x.id==id})[0]}
function price(x,i,s){return x.pr!=null?x.pr:(x.sz?szp(x.sz[s]):x.cols[i].p)}
function f(n){return n.toLocaleString("fr-FR").replace(/[\u202f\u00a0]/g," ")+" FCFA"}
async function hash(s){
 try{var b=await crypto.subtle.digest("SHA-256",new TextEncoder().encode(s));return Array.from(new Uint8Array(b)).map(function(x){return x.toString(16).padStart(2,"0")}).join("")}
 catch(e){var h=5381;for(var i=0;i<s.length;i++)h=((h<<5)+h+s.charCodeAt(i))|0;return "h"+h}
}
function amode(m){
 mode=m;$("gt-in").classList.toggle("on",m=="in");$("gt-up").classList.toggle("on",m=="up");
 $("gn").style.display=m=="up"?"block":"none";$("gb").textContent=m=="up"?"Créer mon compte":"Se connecter";$("gerr").textContent="";
}
async function auth(){
 var em=$("ge").value.trim().toLowerCase(),pw=$("gp").value,nm=$("gn").value.trim(),er=$("gerr");
 if(!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(em)){er.textContent="Entrez une adresse e-mail valide.";return}
 if(pw.length<6){er.textContent="Le mot de passe doit contenir au moins 6 caractères.";return}
 var u=users(),h=await hash(em+":"+pw);
 if(mode=="up"){
  if(!nm){er.textContent="Entrez votre nom.";return}
  if(u[em]){er.textContent="Un compte existe déjà avec cet e-mail. Connectez-vous.";return}
  u[em]={name:nm,ph:h,cart:{},orders:[],idx:{},sel:{}};sv("mg_users",u);
 }else if(!u[em]||u[em].ph!==h){er.textContent="E-mail ou mot de passe incorrect.";return}
 sv("mg_sess",em);sv("mg_last",em);start(em);
}
function start(em){
 var u=users()[em];if(!u)return;
 cur=em;cart=u.cart||{};orders=u.orders||[];idx=u.idx||{};sel=u.sel||{};promo=u.promo||"";ship=u.ship||{ville:"Bamako",adr:"",tel:"",note:""};fav=u.fav||{};
 $("gate").style.display="none";document.body.style.overflow="";
 build();packsR();shipR();render();acctR();infoR();chipsR();tab("shop");
}
function logout(){
 save();rm("mg_sess");cur=null;cart={};orders=[];idx={};sel={};promo="";ship={ville:"Bamako",adr:"",tel:"",note:""};fav={};
 $("gp").value="";$("gate").style.display="flex";document.body.style.overflow="hidden";amode("in");
}
function tab(t){
 ["shop","pack","cart","acct","info"].forEach(function(x){$("v-"+x).style.display=x==t?"block":"none";var b=$("n-"+x);if(b)b.classList.toggle("on",x==t)});
 window.scrollTo(0,0);
}
function card(x){
 var i=idx[x.id]||0,s=ssel(x),sl="",sw="",o="",m=x.cols.length>1;
 x.cols.forEach(function(c,k){
  sl+='<div class="sl1">'+(c.im?'<img src="'+IM[c.im]+'" alt="'+x.n+'">':CI[x.c])+'</div>';
  if(m)sw+='<button class="sw'+(k==i?' on':'')+'" data-p="'+x.id+'" data-i="'+k+'" title="'+c.n+'" aria-label="'+c.n+'" onclick="pick('+x.id+','+k+')"><img src="'+IMT[c.im]+'" alt="" decoding="async"></button>';
 });
 if(x.sz)x.sz.forEach(function(z,k){o+='<option value="'+k+'"'+(k==s?' selected':'')+'>'+szl(z)+'</option>'});
 return '<div class="pc"><div class="pi" onclick="openP('+x.id+')"><button class="hrt'+(fav[x.id]?' on':'')+'" data-p="'+x.id+'" aria-label="Favori" onclick="event.stopPropagation();togFav('+x.id+')">♥</button>'+(x.bd?'<span class="bd">'+x.bd+'</span>':'')+'<div class="sl" data-p="'+x.id+'" style="transform:translateX(-'+i*100+'%)">'+sl+'</div></div><div class="pb"><h4 onclick="openP('+x.id+')">'+x.n+'</h4><div class="sws">'+sw+'</div>'+(x.sz?'<select class="sel" data-p="'+x.id+'" onchange="setSz('+x.id+',this.value)">'+o+'</select>':'')+'<div class="bt"><div class="pr pp" data-p="'+x.id+'">'+pf(price(x,i,s))+'</div><button class="btn ab" data-p="'+x.id+'" onclick="addP('+x.id+')"'+(isOut(x,i)?' disabled':'')+'>'+(isOut(x,i)?'Épuisé':'Ajouter au panier')+'</button></div></div></div>';
}
function upd(id){
 var x=pr(id),i=idx[id]||0,s=ssel(x);
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-p="'+id+'"]').forEach(function(e){
  var c=e.classList;
  if(c.contains("sl"))e.style.transform="translateX(-"+i*100+"%)";
  else if(c.contains("pp"))e.innerHTML=pf(price(x,i,s));
  else if(c.contains("sw"))c.toggle("on",e.dataset.i==i);
  else if(c.contains("sel"))e.value=s;
  else if(c.contains("ab")){var oo=isOut(x,i);e.disabled=oo;e.textContent=oo?"Épuisé":"Ajouter au panier"}
  else if(c.contains("hrt"))c.toggle("on",!!fav[id]);
 });
}
function share(x){return "https://wa.me/?text="+encodeURIComponent("Regarde ce produit sur AST Gaming : "+x.n+" – "+f(price(x,idx[x.id]||0,ssel(x)))+"\n"+location.href)}
function openP(id){
 var ov=$("dov");
 if(!id){ov.classList.remove("on");return}
 var x=pr(id),i=idx[id]||0,s=ssel(x),sl="",sw="",o="",m=x.cols.length>1,sp="",out=isOut(x,i);
 x.cols.forEach(function(c,k){
  sl+='<div class="sl1">'+(c.im?'<img src="'+IM[c.im]+'" alt="'+x.n+'">':CI[x.c])+'</div>';
  if(m)sw+='<button class="sw'+(k==i?' on':'')+'" data-p="'+x.id+'" data-i="'+k+'" title="'+c.n+'" aria-label="'+c.n+'" onclick="pick('+x.id+','+k+')"><img src="'+IMT[c.im]+'" alt="" decoding="async"></button>';
 });
 if(x.sz)x.sz.forEach(function(z,k){o+='<option value="'+k+'"'+(k==s?' selected':'')+'>'+szl(z)+'</option>'});
 (SPECS[id]||[]).forEach(function(t){sp+='<li>'+t+'</li>'});
 $("dbox").innerHTML='<div class="pi"><button class="hrt'+(fav[x.id]?' on':'')+'" data-p="'+x.id+'" aria-label="Favori" onclick="togFav('+x.id+')">♥</button><div class="sl" data-p="'+x.id+'" style="transform:translateX(-'+i*100+'%)">'+sl+'</div></div><div class="pb"><h4>'+x.n+'</h4><div class="sws">'+sw+'</div>'+(x.sz?'<select class="sel" data-p="'+x.id+'" onchange="setSz('+x.id+',this.value)">'+o+'</select>':'')+'<ul class="spec">'+sp+'</ul><div class="sm2">🚚 Livraison estimée : '+DELAI+'</div><div class="bt"><div class="pr pp" data-p="'+x.id+'">'+pf(price(x,i,s))+'</div><button class="btn ab" data-p="'+x.id+'" onclick="addP('+x.id+')"'+(out?' disabled':'')+'>'+(out?'Épuisé':'Ajouter au panier')+'</button><a class="btn wa" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+share(x)+'">Partager sur WhatsApp</a></div></div>';
 ov.classList.add("on");
}
function pick(id,i){idx[id]=i;lk[id]=Date.now()+8000;upd(id);save()}
function setSz(id,v){sel[id]=+v;upd(id);save()}

var CFL=[["noir","Noir"],["blanc","Blanc"],["gris","Gris"],["rouge","Rouge"],["rose","Rose"],["orange","Orange"],["vert","Vert"],["bleu","Bleu"],["violet","Violet"]];
function nrm(t){return t.toLowerCase().normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"")}
function cfIdx(x){if(!cf)return -1;for(var k=0;k<x.cols.length;k++)if(nrm(x.cols[k].n).indexOf(cf)>-1)return k;return -1}
function setSort(v){sortM=v;build()}
function setCf(v){cf=v;chipsR();build()}
function chipsR(){
 var h='<button class="chip'+(cf?'':' on')+'" onclick="setCf(\'\')">Toutes les couleurs</button>';
 CFL.forEach(function(c){h+='<button class="chip'+(cf==c[0]?' on':'')+'" onclick="setCf(\''+(cf==c[0]?'':c[0])+'\')">'+c[1]+'</button>'});
 $("chips").innerHTML=h;
}
function build(){
 var h="";
 BAN.forEach(function(x){h+='<div class="ban" style="background:'+x.bg+'"><span class="big">'+x.i+'</span><div><h3>'+x.t+'</h3><p>'+x.s+'</p></div><button class="glass" onclick="go(\''+x.c+'\')">'+x.b+'</button></div>'});
 $("bans").innerHTML=h;
 h=head("LES PRODUITS HYPE","car-hype")+'<div class="car" id="car-hype">';
 [2,3,9].forEach(function(id){h+=card(pr(id))});
 $("hype").innerHTML=h+'</div>';
 h="";
 CATS.forEach(function(c){
  var L=P.filter(function(x){return x.c==c[0]&&(!cf||cfIdx(x)>-1)});
  if(cf&&!L.length)return;
  if(sortM!="def")L.sort(function(a,b){var pa=price(a,0,ssel(a)),pb=price(b,0,ssel(b));return sortM=="asc"?pa-pb:pb-pa});
  h+='<div id="s-'+c[0]+'">'+head(c[1].toUpperCase(),"car-"+c[0])+'<div class="car" id="car-'+c[0]+'">';
  L.forEach(function(x){if(cf){var k=cfIdx(x);if(k>-1){idx[x.id]=k;lk[x.id]=Date.now()+60000}}h+=card(x)});
  h+='</div></div>';
 });
 $("cats").innerHTML=h;
}
function isOut(x,i){return !!(x.out||x.cols[i].out)}
function addP(id){var x=pr(id),i=idx[id]||0,s=ssel(x),k=id+"|"+i+"|"+s;if(isOut(x,i))return;cart[k]=cart[k]||{id:id,i:i,s:s,q:0};cart[k].q++;save();render();flyAdd(id,x.cols[i].im?IM[x.cols[i].im]:"")}
function chg(k,d){cart[k].q+=d;if(cart[k].q<=0)delete cart[k];save();render()}
var PK=[{id:1,n:"Pack AST",items:[{p:2,i:2},{p:4,kb:1},{p:9,i:0},{p:5,i:0}],pr:null}];
function pkById(id){return PK.filter(function(k){return k.id==id})[0]}
function pkk(pk){return sel["pk"+pk.id]||0}
function pkPrice(pk){if(pk.pr!=null)return pk.pr;var t=0;pk.items.forEach(function(it){var x=pr(it.p);t+=price(x,it.i||0,ssel(x))});return t}
function unit(o){return o.pk?pkPrice(pkById(o.pk)):price(pr(o.id),o.i,o.s)}
function packsR(){
 var h='<div class="ttl">[ PACK INFLUENCEUR ]</div>';
 PK.forEach(function(pk){
  var kb=pkk(pk),imgs="",lines="",sw="",kx=null;
  pk.items.forEach(function(it){
   var x=pr(it.p),c=x.cols[it.kb?kb:(it.i||0)];
   imgs+='<img src="'+IM[c.im]+'" alt="'+x.n+'">';
   if(it.kb){kx=x;lines+='<div class="pkl"><span>'+CI[x.c]+' '+x.n+'</span><b>'+c.n+'</b></div>'}
   else lines+='<div class="pkl"><span>'+CI[x.c]+' '+x.n+'</span><b>'+c.n+'</b></div>';
  });
  kx.cols.forEach(function(c,k){sw+='<button class="sw'+(k==kb?' on':'')+'" title="'+c.n+'" aria-label="'+c.n+'" onclick="pkPick('+pk.id+','+k+')"><img src="'+IMT[c.im]+'" alt="" decoding="async"></button>'});
  h+='<div class="pkc"><div class="pkg">'+imgs+'</div><div class="pb"><h4>'+pk.n+'</h4>'+lines+'<div class="sws" style="margin-top:4px">'+sw+'</div><div class="bt"><div class="pr">'+pf(pkPrice(pk))+'</div><button class="btn" onclick="addPk('+pk.id+')">Ajouter le pack au panier</button></div></div></div>';
 });
 $("v-pack").innerHTML=h;
}
function pkPick(id,k){sel["pk"+id]=k;packsR();save()}
function addPk(id){var pk=pkById(id),k="pk|"+id+"|"+pkk(pk);cart[k]=cart[k]||{pk:id,id:id,i:pkk(pk),s:0,q:0};cart[k].q++;save();render();var f0=pk.items[0],x0=pr(f0.p);flyAdd(id,IM[x0.cols[f0.i||0].im],document.querySelector('#v-pack .pkg'))}
function lbl(o){
 if(o.pk){var pk=pkById(o.pk);return pk.n+" ("+pk.items.map(function(it){var x=pr(it.p),c=x.cols[it.kb?o.i:(it.i||0)];return x.n+" "+c.n}).join(" + ")+")"}
 var x=pr(o.id),l=x.n;if(x.cols[0].im)l+=" – "+x.cols[o.i].n;if(x.sz)l+=" – "+szl(x.sz[o.s]);return l}
function togFav(id){if(fav[id])delete fav[id];else fav[id]=1;upd(id);save();acctR()}
function favH(){
 var ids=Object.keys(fav).filter(function(k){return fav[k]&&pr(+k)});
 var h='<h2 class="s">❤️ Mes favoris</h2>';
 if(!ids.length)return h+'<div class="box"><small>Touchez le cœur sur un produit pour le garder ici.</small></div>';
 h+='<div class="box">';
 ids.forEach(function(k){var x=pr(+k),i=idx[x.id]||0;h+='<div class="sg"><img src="'+IMT[x.cols[i].im]+'" alt=""><div><b>'+x.n+'</b><br><span class="pr">'+pf(price(x,i,ssel(x)))+'</span></div><button class="btn" onclick="openP('+x.id+')">Voir</button></div>'});
 return h+'</div>';
}
function sugR(){
 var el=$("sug");if(!el)return;
 var ks=Object.keys(cart);
 if(!ks.length){el.innerHTML="";return}
 var have={};ks.forEach(function(k){var o=cart[k];if(o.pk){have.souris=have.clavier=have.tapis=have.casque=1}else have[pr(o.id).c]=1});
 var picks={souris:2,clavier:3,tapis:9,casque:5},h="",n=0;
 ["souris","clavier","tapis","casque"].forEach(function(c){
  if(have[c]||n>=3)return;n++;
  var x=pr(picks[c]),i=idx[x.id]||0;
  h+='<div class="sg"><img src="'+IM[x.cols[i].im]+'" alt=""><div><b>'+x.n+'</b><br><span class="pr">'+pf(price(x,i,ssel(x)))+'</span></div><button class="btn" onclick="addP('+x.id+')">+ Ajouter</button></div>';
 });
 el.innerHTML=h?'<h3 class="sgt">✨ Complète ton setup</h3><div class="box">'+h+'</div>':"";
}
function cdTick(){
 var el=$("cd");if(!el)return;
 var t=Date.parse(OFFRE.fin)-Date.now();
 if(t<=0){if(el.style.display!="none"){el.style.display="none";render();refreshPrices()}return}
 el.style.display="flex";
 function z(n){return (n<10?"0":"")+n}
 $("cd-t").innerHTML='⏳ <b>'+OFFRE.txt+'</b> · −'+PROMOS[OFFRE.code].pct+' % avec le code <b>'+OFFRE.code+'</b>';
 $("cd-d").textContent=z(Math.floor(t/864e5));$("cd-h").textContent=z(Math.floor(t%864e5/36e5));$("cd-m").textContent=z(Math.floor(t%36e5/6e4));$("cd-s").textContent=z(Math.floor(t%6e4/1e3));
}
function useOffer(){promoBox(1);if(pinfo(1))return;$("pcode2").value=OFFRE.code;applyPromo("pcode2","perr2",1)}
function thumbOf(o){
 if(o.pk){var pk=pkById(o.pk),h='<div class="ci cp">';pk.items.forEach(function(it){var x=pr(it.p);h+='<img src="'+IMT[x.cols[it.kb?o.i:(it.i||0)].im]+'" alt="">'});return h+'</div>'}
 var x=pr(o.id);return x.cols[o.i].im?'<img class="ci" src="'+IM[x.cols[o.i].im]+'" alt="">':'<div class="ci">'+CI[x.c]+'</div>';
}
var tt=null;
function toast(t){var e=$("toast");e.textContent=t;e.classList.add("on");clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(function(){e.classList.remove("on")},1500)}
function flyAdd(id,src,fromEl){
 try{
  var from=null;
  if(fromEl){var r0=fromEl.getBoundingClientRect();if(r0.width>0)from=r0}
  else{var els=document.querySelectorAll('.sl[data-p="'+id+'"]');for(var j=0;j<els.length;j++){var r=els[j].getBoundingClientRect();if(r.width>0&&r.bottom>0&&r.top<innerHeight){from=r;break}}}
  var nb=$("n-cart"),to=nb.getBoundingClientRect();
  if(from&&src){
   var im=document.createElement("img");im.src=src;im.className="fly";
   im.style.cssText="left:"+from.left+"px;top:"+from.top+"px;width:"+from.width+"px;height:"+from.height+"px";
   document.body.appendChild(im);im.getBoundingClientRect();
   im.style.transform="translate("+(to.left+to.width/2-(from.left+from.width/2))+"px,"+(to.top+to.height/2-(from.top+from.height/2))+"px) scale(.1)";im.style.opacity=".35";
   setTimeout(function(){im.remove()},760);
  }
  nb.classList.remove("pulse");void nb.offsetWidth;nb.classList.add("pulse");
  var b=$("cnt");b.classList.remove("bump");void b.offsetWidth;b.classList.add("bump");
 }catch(e){}
 toast("✓ Ajouté au panier");
}
function pf(p){var d=pinfo(1);if(!d)return f(p);return '<s class="old">'+f(p)+'</s> <span class="new">'+f(p-Math.round(p*d.pct/100))+'</span>'}
function refreshPrices(){P.forEach(function(x){upd(x.id)});if(cur)packsR();var q=$("q");if(q&&q.value)srch(q.value)}
function pinfo(t){var p=PROMOS[promo];if(!p||(p.first&&orders.length>0)||(p.fin&&Date.now()>Date.parse(p.fin)))return null;return {code:promo,pct:p.pct,amt:Math.round(t*p.pct/100)}}
function pstate(){var b=$("pbtn");if(b)b.classList.toggle("on",!!pinfo(1))}
function applyPromo(inp,err,modal){
 inp=inp||"pcode";err=err||"perr";
 var c=$(inp).value.trim().toUpperCase(),er=$(err),p=PROMOS[c];
 if(!c){er.textContent="Entrez un code promo.";return}
 if(!p){er.textContent="Code promo invalide.";return}
 if(p.fin&&Date.now()>Date.parse(p.fin)){er.textContent="Ce code a expiré.";return}
 if(p.first&&orders.length>0){er.textContent="Ce code est valable uniquement sur votre première commande.";return}
 promo=c;save();render();refreshPrices();if(modal)promoBox(1);
}
function rmPromo(){promo="";save();render();refreshPrices();if($("pov").classList.contains("on"))promoBox(1)}
function promoBox(o){
 if(o){
  var d=pinfo(1);
  $("pbox").innerHTML='<h3>🏷️ Code promo</h3>'+(d?'<p>Code <b>'+d.code+'</b> appliqué (−'+d.pct+' %). La réduction sera déduite de votre commande.</p><button class="btn" onclick="rmPromo()">Retirer le code</button>':'<div class="promo"><input class="in" id="pcode2" placeholder="Entrez votre code" autocapitalize="characters"><button class="btn" onclick="applyPromo(\'pcode2\',\'perr2\',1)">Appliquer</button></div><div class="err" id="perr2"></div>');
 }
 $("pov").classList.toggle("on",!!o);
}
function zone(v){for(var i=0;i<VILLES.length;i++)if(VILLES[i][0]==v)return VILLES[i][1];return 2}
function shipFee(){return FRAIS[zone(ship.ville)]}
function shipSet(k,v){ship[k]=v;save();render()}
function shipR(){
 var o="";VILLES.forEach(function(v){o+='<option'+(v[0]==ship.ville?' selected':'')+'>'+v[0]+'</option>'});
 $("shipbox").innerHTML='<select class="sel" onchange="shipSet(\'ville\',this.value)">'+o+'</select><input class="in" placeholder="Quartier, rue, repère (adresse de livraison)" value="'+esc(ship.adr)+'" oninput="shipSet(\'adr\',this.value)"><input class="in" type="tel" placeholder="Téléphone (WhatsApp / Orange Money)" value="'+esc(ship.tel)+'" oninput="shipSet(\'tel\',this.value)"><input class="in" placeholder="Remarque (facultatif)" value="'+esc(ship.note)+'" oninput="shipSet(\'note\',this.value)"><div class="sm2">🚚 Délai estimé : '+DELAI+' après confirmation du paiement.</div>';
}
function render(){
 var ks=Object.keys(cart),h="",t=0,n=0,u=cur&&users()[cur],nm=u?u.name:"";
 lastItems=[];lastPromo="";pend="MG-"+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase().slice(-6);
 var msg="Bonjour, c’est "+nm+" ("+(cur||"")+"). Je souhaite commander ("+pend+") :\n";
 if(!ks.length){$("cart").innerHTML='<small>Votre panier est vide.</small>';$("co").innerHTML=""}
 else{
  ks.forEach(function(k){
   var o=cart[k],sub=unit(o)*o.q,line=o.q+" x "+lbl(o)+" = "+f(sub);
   t+=sub;n+=o.q;msg+="- "+line+"\n";lastItems.push(line);
   h+='<div class="row ir">'+thumbOf(o)+'<div class="im"><span>'+lbl(o)+'</span><span class="q"><button onclick="chg(\''+k+'\',-1)">−</button> '+o.q+' <button onclick="chg(\''+k+'\',1)">+</button></span></div><b>'+f(sub)+'</b></div>';
  });
  var d=pinfo(t),base=t-(d?d.amt:0),fee=base>=FREE?0:shipFee(),fin=base+fee;
  if(promo&&!d)promo="";
  if(d){
   lastPromo=d.code+" (−"+d.pct+" %) : −"+f(d.amt)+(PROMOS[d.code]&&PROMOS[d.code].inf?" – code influenceur":"");msg+="Code promo "+lastPromo+"\n";
   h+='<div class="row"><span>Sous-total</span><span>'+f(t)+'</span></div>';
   h+='<div class="row"><span>🏷️ Code '+d.code+' (−'+d.pct+' %)</span><span><b>−'+f(d.amt)+'</b> <button class="lnk" onclick="rmPromo()">Retirer</button></span></div>';
  }else{
   h+='<div class="promo"><input class="in" id="pcode" placeholder="Code promo" autocapitalize="characters"><button class="btn" onclick="applyPromo()">Appliquer</button></div><div class="err" id="perr"></div>';
  }
  h+='<div class="row"><span>🚚 Livraison ('+esc(ship.ville)+')</span><span>'+(fee?f(fee):'<b class="free">Offerte 🎉</b>')+'</span></div>';if(fee)h+='<div class="fr"><div class="frb"><i style="width:'+Math.min(100,Math.round(base*100/FREE))+'%"></i></div><small>Plus que '+f(FREE-base)+' pour la livraison offerte 🎁</small></div>';
  h+='<div class="row"><b>Total</b><b class="pr">'+f(fin)+'</b></div>';
  lastTotal=fin;lastFee=fee;
  var ok=ship.adr.trim().length>3&&ship.tel.replace(/\D/g,"").length>=8;
  lastShip=ship.ville+", "+ship.adr.trim()+" – Tél : "+ship.tel.trim()+(ship.note.trim()?" – Remarque : "+ship.note.trim():"");
  msg+="Livraison : "+(fee?f(fee):"offerte")+" ("+lastShip+")\nTotal : "+f(fin)+"\nPaiement : Orange Money";
  $("cart").innerHTML=h;
  $("co").innerHTML=ok?'<a class="btn wa" style="display:block" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+wa(msg)+'" onclick="placeOrder()">Commander sur WhatsApp</a><div class="sm2">Délai estimé : '+DELAI+'</div>':'<button class="btn" style="display:block;width:100%;opacity:.5" disabled>Commander sur WhatsApp</button><div class="err">Renseignez l’adresse de livraison et votre téléphone pour commander.</div>';
 }
 var c=$("cnt");c.textContent=n;c.style.display=n?"inline-block":"none";pstate();sugR();
}
function placeOrder(){
 if(!lastItems.length)return;
 orders.unshift({id:pend,d:new Date().toLocaleDateString("fr-FR"),items:lastItems.slice(),total:lastTotal,pr:lastPromo,ad:lastShip,fee:lastFee,st:"Envoyée sur WhatsApp"});
 cart={};promo="";save();
 setTimeout(function(){render();refreshPrices();acctR();tab("acct")},600);
}
function acctR(){
 var u=cur&&users()[cur];if(!u)return;
 var h='<h2 class="s">👤 Mon compte</h2><div class="box"><b>'+esc(u.name)+'</b><br><small>'+esc(cur)+'</small><br><br><button class="btn" onclick="logout()">Changer de compte</button><br><small>Vous restez connecté sur cet appareil jusqu’à ce que vous changiez de compte.</small></div>'+favH()+'<h2 class="s">📦 Mes commandes</h2>';
 if(!orders.length)h+='<div class="box"><small>Aucune commande pour le moment.</small></div>';
 orders.forEach(function(o,i){
  h+='<div class="box"><div class="row"><b>'+o.id+'</b><small>'+o.d+'</small></div>';
  o.items.forEach(function(l){h+='<div class="oi">'+esc(l)+'</div>'});
  if(o.pr)h+='<div class="oi">🏷️ Code promo '+esc(o.pr)+'</div>';if(o.ad)h+='<div class="oi">📍 '+esc(o.ad)+'</div><div class="oi">🚚 Livraison : '+(o.fee?f(o.fee):"offerte")+'</div>';h+='<div class="row"><b>Total</b><b>'+f(o.total)+'</b></div><div class="row"><span class="st">'+o.st+'</span>';
  if(o.st!="Remboursement demandé")h+='<a class="btn rf" target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="'+wa("Bonjour, je souhaite demander le remboursement de ma commande "+o.id+" ("+o.items.join(", ")+"). Total : "+f(o.total)+". Client : "+u.name+" ("+cur+")")+'" onclick="refund('+i+')">Demander un remboursement</a>';
  h+='</div></div>';
 });
 $("acct").innerHTML=h;
}
function infoR(){
 var fr="Bamako et Kati : "+f(FRAIS[1])+" · Autres villes : "+f(FRAIS[2]);
 var sec=[["🛒 Comment commander",'<ol><li>Créez un compte ou connectez-vous.</li><li>Choisissez vos produits (couleur, taille) et ajoutez-les au panier.</li><li>Ouvrez <b>Mon panier</b>, renseignez votre adresse et votre téléphone.</li><li>Appuyez sur « Commander sur WhatsApp » : votre commande nous est envoyée.</li><li>Payez par Orange Money au <b>79 30 38 41</b> et envoyez la capture.</li><li>Nous confirmons et préparons l’expédition.</li></ol>'],
 ["🚚 Livraison et délais","<p>Nos produits sont expédiés depuis l’étranger. Délai estimé : <b>"+DELAI+"</b> après confirmation du paiement.</p><p>Frais de livraison : "+fr+". <b>Livraison offerte dès "+f(FREE)+" d’achat.</b></p><p>Nous vous prévenons sur WhatsApp à chaque étape.</p>"],
 ["↩️ Remboursement",'<p>Pour demander un remboursement : <b>Mon compte → Mes commandes → Demander un remboursement</b>, ou écrivez-nous sur WhatsApp avec votre numéro de commande.</p><ul><li>Commande non expédiée : remboursement intégral.</li><li>Produit défectueux ou non conforme : signalez-le dans les 7 jours après réception, avec des photos.</li><li>Le remboursement se fait par Orange Money après vérification.</li></ul>'],
 ["💬 Nous contacter",'<p>WhatsApp : <a href="https://wa.me/22379303841" target="_blank" rel="noopener">+223 79 30 38 41</a></p>']];
 var h='<div class="ttl">[ INFOS & AIDE ]</div>';
 sec.forEach(function(x,i){h+='<details class="dt"'+(i==0?' open':'')+'><summary>'+x[0]+'</summary>'+x[1]+'</details>'});
 $("v-info").innerHTML=h;
}
function refund(i){orders[i].st="Remboursement demandé";save();setTimeout(acctR,600)}
var AN=["Livraison au Mali en "+DELAI+" 🚚","Livraison offerte dès "+f(FREE)+" 🎁","Paiement par Orange Money 🧡","Commande facile sur WhatsApp 💬"],ai=0;
function ann(d){ai=(ai+d+AN.length)%AN.length;$("ann").textContent=AN[ai]}
function menu(o){$("ov").classList.toggle("on",!!o)}
function go2(c){menu(0);if(c=="pack"||c=="info")tab(c);else go(c)}
function srch(v){
 v=v.trim().toLowerCase();var r=$("res");
 if(!v){r.innerHTML="";return}
 var m=P.filter(function(x){return (x.n+" "+x.d).toLowerCase().indexOf(v)>-1}),h="";
 m.forEach(function(x){h+=card(x)});
 r.innerHTML='<div class="ttl">[ RÉSULTATS ]</div>'+(h?'<div class="car wrap">'+h+'</div>':'<p>Aucun produit trouvé.</p>');
}
var MN=[["souris","SOURIS"],["clavier","CLAVIERS"],["tapis","TAPIS DE SOURIS"],["casque","CASQUES & AUDIO"],["pack","PACK INFLUENCEUR"],["info","INFOS & AIDE"]],mh="";
MN.forEach(function(m){mh+='<div class="mi" onclick="go2(\''+m[0]+'\')"><span>'+m[1]+'</span><i>›</i></div>'});
$("mi").innerHTML=mh;
ann(0);setInterval(function(){ann(1)},4000);cdTick();setInterval(cdTick,1000);
setInterval(function(){if(!cur)return;P.forEach(function(x){if(x.cols.length>1&&!(lk[x.id]>Date.now())){idx[x.id]=((idx[x.id]||0)+1)%x.cols.length;upd(x.id)}})},3000);
document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){if(document.hidden)save()});
window.addEventListener("pagehide",save);
async function boot(){
 document.body.style.overflow="hidden";
 IDB=await idbOpen();
 try{if(navigator.storage&&navigator.storage.persist)navigator.storage.persist()}catch(e){}
 var ks=["mg_users","mg_sess","mg_last"];
 for(var j=0;j<ks.length;j++){if(ld(ks[j])==null){var v=await idbGet(ks[j]);if(v!=null)sv(ks[j],v)}}
 var l=ld("mg_last");if(l)$("ge").value=l;
 var s0=ld("mg_sess");
 if(s0&&users()[s0])start(s0);
}
boot();
</script>
</body>
</html>
